summary_1line: Bhishma and Vyasa describe the duties of the forest-dwelling stage and transition to renunciation, emphasizing austerity, ritual discipline, and detachment leading toward liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: An aged man with white hair sits in the forest surrounded by four blazing fires while the sun burns overhead, performing severe austerity.
A forest recluse in simple bark garments offers clarified butter into a small sacred fire beside a hut of leaves.
An old ascetic shaves his head beside a river at dawn before entering the final life of renunciation.
